source: hand-written catalog (digitva-qwvt), operational questions added 2026-10-27; comparative, staff and coder questions 2026-10-27

questions.question: How many cases are there in total?
questions.description: All submissions in your scope.
questions.sql: SELECT sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube

questions.question: How many cases does each project have?
questions.description: Submissions per project.
questions.sql: SELECT project_id, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question: What share of cases is coded at each site, against all sites?
questions.description: Cases with a final cause as a percentage of all cases, per site, with the all-sites share and rank.
questions.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE true) AS base, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source IS NOT NULL) AS hits FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(hits, 0) AS coded, round(100.0 * hits / NULLIF(base, 0), 1) AS coded_pct, round(100.0 * sum(hits) OVER () / NULLIF(sum(base) OVER (), 0), 1) AS all_sites_pct, rank() OVER (ORDER BY hits::numeric / NULLIF(base, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM s ORDER BY coded_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many cases are waiting for coding at each site?
questions.description: Cases ready for coding or being coded, per site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'ready_for_coding') AS ready, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'coding_in_progress') AS in_progress FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY ready DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many cases were marked not codeable at each site?
questions.description: Cases not codeable by the coder or the data manager, per site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'not_codeable_by_coder') AS by_coder, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'not_codeable_by_data_manager') AS by_data_manager FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY site_id

questions.question: Who gave the final cause: coder or reviewer?
questions.description: Coded cases by the source of the final cause.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_source, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY authoritative_source ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question: How many cases came in each month over the last year?
questions.description: Submissions per month for the last 12 months.
questions.sql: SELECT submission_month, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE submission_month >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '11 months' GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month

questions.question: Monthly cases by site
questions.description: Submissions per month for the five largest sites.
questions.sql: WITH top_sites AS (SELECT site_id FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY sum(n) DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT submission_month, site_id, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE site_id IN (SELECT site_id FROM top_sites) AND submission_month IS NOT NULL GROUP BY submission_month, site_id ORDER BY submission_month, site_id

questions.question: How many cases were submitted each year?
questions.description: Submissions per calendar year.
questions.sql: SELECT extract(year FROM submission_month)::int AS year, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE submission_month IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: How many deaths are there in each age band?
questions.description: Cases per analytics age band.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY deaths DESC

questions.question: How many deaths are male and female?
questions.description: Cases by sex of the deceased.
questions.sql: SELECT lower(sex) AS sex, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube GROUP BY lower(sex) ORDER BY deaths DESC

questions.question: What are the top 10 final causes of death?
questions.description: Most frequent WHO 2026 VA causes of the final cause.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_who_bucket, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY authoritative_who_bucket ORDER BY deaths DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: What are the top causes of neonatal deaths?
questions.description: Top 10 final causes among neonates.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_who_bucket, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE analytics_age_band = 'neonate' AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY authoritative_who_bucket ORDER BY deaths DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: What are the top causes of child deaths?
questions.description: Top 10 final causes among children.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_who_bucket, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE analytics_age_band = 'child' AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY authoritative_who_bucket ORDER BY deaths DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Cause sections by sex
questions.description: Deaths per WHO 2026 VA cause section, male and female.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_who_bucket_section, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'male') AS male, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'female') AS female FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL GROUP BY authoritative_who_bucket_section ORDER BY authoritative_who_bucket_section

questions.question: How many deaths from external causes in each age band?
questions.description: Deaths in the external causes section per age band.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'External causes of death' GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY deaths DESC

questions.question: What share of coded deaths has an unknown cause at each site, against all sites?
questions.description: Coded deaths in the cause-unknown section as a percentage of coded deaths per site, with the all-sites share.
questions.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL) AS base, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Cause of death unknown') AS hits FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(hits, 0) AS unknown, round(100.0 * hits / NULLIF(base, 0), 1) AS unknown_pct, round(100.0 * sum(hits) OVER () / NULLIF(sum(base) OVER (), 0), 1) AS all_sites_pct, rank() OVER (ORDER BY hits::numeric / NULLIF(base, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM s ORDER BY unknown_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How often does SmartVA agree with the final cause?
questions.description: Coded cases with a SmartVA cause where the SmartVA top cause matches the final cause.
questions.sql: SELECT sum(n) FILTER (WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL) AS compared, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket = authoritative_who_bucket) AS agree, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket = authoritative_who_bucket) / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS agree_pct FROM ai_cube

questions.question: What is the average narrative quality score at each site, against all sites?
questions.description: Mean narrative quality score per site, with the all-sites mean and rank.
questions.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_id, sum(nqa_score_sum) AS score, sum(nqa_scored_n) AS scored FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, scored, round(score::numeric / NULLIF(scored, 0), 2) AS avg_score, round(sum(score) OVER ()::numeric / NULLIF(sum(scored) OVER (), 0), 2) AS all_sites_avg, rank() OVER (ORDER BY score::numeric / NULLIF(scored, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM s WHERE scored > 0 ORDER BY avg_score DESC

questions.question: Narrative quality ratings by site
questions.description: Cases rated Good, Fair and Poor, per site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nqa_rating = 'Good') AS good, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nqa_rating = 'Fair') AS fair, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nqa_rating = 'Poor') AS poor FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY site_id

questions.question: What is the workflow state of cases at each site?
questions.description: Cases per site split by workflow state.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, workflow_state, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id, workflow_state ORDER BY site_id, cases DESC

questions.question: Which sites have cases waiting for attachments to sync?
questions.description: Cases held in attachment sync pending, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) AS waiting FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state = 'attachment_sync_pending' GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY waiting DESC

questions.question: Which sites have the most consent refusals, against all sites?
questions.description: Consent-refused cases and their share of all cases per site, with the all-sites rate.
questions.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE true) AS base, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'consent_refused') AS hits FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(hits, 0) AS refused, round(100.0 * hits / NULLIF(base, 0), 1) AS refused_pct, round(100.0 * sum(hits) OVER () / NULLIF(sum(base) OVER (), 0), 1) AS all_sites_pct, rank() OVER (ORDER BY hits::numeric / NULLIF(base, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM s ORDER BY refused_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Is consent refusal rising or falling month by month?
questions.description: Consent-refused cases per submission month.
questions.sql: SELECT submission_month, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'consent_refused') AS refused, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month

questions.question: How many cases were marked not codeable by data managers and by coders?
questions.description: Not-codeable cases by who decided, per site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'not_codeable_by_data_manager') AS by_data_manager, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state = 'not_codeable_by_coder') AS by_coder FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id HAVING sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state IN ('not_codeable_by_data_manager', 'not_codeable_by_coder')) > 0 ORDER BY site_id

questions.question: How does this month's intake compare with last month at each site?
questions.description: Cases submitted this calendar month (so far) and last month by site, with the change and percent change.
questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date) AS this_month, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '1 month')::date) AS last_month FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(this_month, 0) AS this_month, coalesce(last_month, 0) AS last_month, coalesce(this_month, 0) - coalesce(last_month, 0) AS change, round(100.0 * (coalesce(this_month, 0) - last_month) / NULLIF(last_month, 0), 1) AS change_pct FROM m ORDER BY change

questions.question: Which sites have sent no cases this month?
questions.description: Sites with earlier cases but none submitted in the current month.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) AS cases_ever, max(submission_month) AS last_month_with_cases FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id HAVING coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)), 0) = 0 ORDER BY last_month_with_cases

questions.question: Which sites have cases with sex or age band missing?
questions.description: Data quality: cases with sex or age band unknown or blank, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE sex IS NULL OR lower(sex) IN ('unknown', 'undetermined', '')) AS sex_missing, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band IS NULL OR analytics_age_band = 'unknown') AS age_missing, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY sex_missing DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Which sites have the most poor or ungradable narratives?
questions.description: Share of NQA-rated cases rated Poor or Cannot Grade, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nqa_rating IN ('Poor', 'Cannot Grade')) AS poor_or_ungradable, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nqa_rating IN ('Poor', 'Cannot Grade')) / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE nqa_rating IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS poor_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY poor_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many coded cases are waiting for a reviewer at each site?
questions.description: Cases in reviewer-eligible state, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) AS awaiting_review FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state = 'reviewer_eligible' GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY awaiting_review DESC

questions.question: How many cases did each project receive per month?
questions.description: Monthly intake by project.
questions.sql: SELECT submission_month, project_id, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube GROUP BY submission_month, project_id ORDER BY submission_month, project_id

questions.question: How old is the coding backlog by the month cases came in?
questions.description: Cases still ready for coding, by submission month: older months are the oldest waiting cases.
questions.sql: SELECT submission_month, sum(n) AS ready_for_coding FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state = 'ready_for_coding' GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month

questions.question: Which age groups are waiting in the coding queue?
questions.description: Ready-for-coding cases by age band.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, sum(n) AS ready_for_coding FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state = 'ready_for_coding' GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY ready_for_coding DESC

questions.question: How good are the narratives of cases waiting to be coded?
questions.description: NQA rating mix of the ready-for-coding queue.
questions.sql: SELECT coalesce(nqa_rating, 'Not rated') AS nqa_rating, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state = 'ready_for_coding' GROUP BY coalesce(nqa_rating, 'Not rated') ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question: How many cases were finalised each month, coder versus reviewer?
questions.description: Finalised cases by submission month and who holds the final cause.
questions.sql: SELECT submission_month, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source = 'coder') AS coder_final, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source = 'reviewer') AS reviewer_final FROM ai_cube GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month

questions.question: Is the share of unknown causes improving over time?
questions.description: Percent of finalised causes in the 'Cause of death unknown' section, per month.
questions.sql: SELECT submission_month, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Cause of death unknown') / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS unknown_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month

questions.question: In which age groups are causes most often unknown?
questions.description: Percent of finalised causes that are unknown, by age band.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Cause of death unknown') / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS unknown_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY unknown_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: What are the most coded ICD codes this month?
questions.description: Top 15 final ICD codes for cases submitted this month.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_icd, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_icd IS NOT NULL AND submission_month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY authoritative_icd ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: Where does SmartVA most often disagree with the final cause?
questions.description: Top 15 SmartVA-cause versus final-cause pairs that differ.
questions.sql: SELECT smartva_cause1_who_bucket AS smartva_cause, authoritative_who_bucket AS final_cause, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL AND smartva_cause1_who_bucket <> authoritative_who_bucket GROUP BY smartva_cause1_who_bucket, authoritative_who_bucket ORDER BY cases DESC LIMIT 15

questions.question: At which sites does the reviewer hold the final cause most often?
questions.description: Share of finalised cases where the reviewer's cause is authoritative, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source = 'reviewer') / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS reviewer_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY reviewer_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: What are the top five causes of death in each age group?
questions.description: Five leading WHO VA causes within each age band.
questions.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT analytics_age_band, authoritative_who_bucket, sum(n) AS cases, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY sum(n) DESC) AS rnk FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY analytics_age_band, authoritative_who_bucket) SELECT analytics_age_band, authoritative_who_bucket, cases FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5 ORDER BY analytics_age_band, cases DESC

questions.question: How many maternal deaths are there, and from which causes?
questions.description: Deaths in the pregnancy, childbirth and puerperium section, by cause.
questions.sql: SELECT authoritative_who_bucket, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Pregnancy-, childbirth and puerperium-related disorders' GROUP BY authoritative_who_bucket ORDER BY deaths DESC

questions.question: Which sites report maternal deaths?
questions.description: Maternal deaths by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) AS maternal_deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Pregnancy-, childbirth and puerperium-related disorders' GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY maternal_deaths DESC

questions.question: What share of deaths under 15 are neonatal?
questions.description: Neonate deaths as a share of neonate plus child deaths, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = 'neonate') AS neonatal, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = 'child') AS child, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = 'neonate') / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band IN ('neonate', 'child')), 0), 1) AS neonatal_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY neonatal_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many stillbirths are recorded at each site?
questions.description: Cases in the stillbirths section, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) AS stillbirths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Stillbirths' GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY stillbirths DESC

questions.question: Who dies of injuries, by sex and age?
questions.description: External-cause deaths by age band and sex.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'male') AS male, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'female') AS female FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'External causes of death' GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY analytics_age_band

questions.question: What share of adult deaths are from non-communicable diseases?
questions.description: Adults (15+): circulatory, neoplasms, NCD, respiratory, renal, endocrine and digestive sections as a share of known causes.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IN ('Diseases of the circulatory system', 'Neoplasms', 'Non-communicable diseases', 'Respiratory disorders', 'Renal disorders', 'Nutritional and endocrine disorders', 'Gastrointestinal disorders')) / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_who_bucket_section <> 'Cause of death unknown'), 0), 1) AS ncd_pct FROM ai_cube WHERE analytics_age_band IN ('15_49y', '50_64y', '65_plus') GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY analytics_age_band

questions.question: Are infectious disease deaths changing quarter by quarter?
questions.description: Infectious and parasitic deaths and their share, per quarter.
questions.sql: SELECT date_trunc('quarter', submission_month) AS quarter, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Infectious and parasitic diseases') AS infectious, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Infectious and parasitic diseases') / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS infectious_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY date_trunc('quarter', submission_month) ORDER BY quarter

questions.question: How many male deaths are there per 100 female deaths in each age group?
questions.description: Male-to-female death ratio by age band.
questions.sql: SELECT analytics_age_band, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'male') AS male, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'female') AS female, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'male') / NULLIF(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'female'), 0), 0) AS males_per_100_females FROM ai_cube GROUP BY analytics_age_band ORDER BY analytics_age_band

questions.question: What share of cases in each project has a final cause?
questions.description: Programme completeness: percent of cases with a finalised cause, by project.
questions.sql: SELECT project_id, sum(n) AS cases, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0), 1) AS with_final_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY project_id ORDER BY project_id

questions.question: How does each month compare with the same month last year?
questions.description: Cases per calendar month, this year against last year.
questions.sql: SELECT extract(month FROM submission_month) AS month_no, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM submission_month) = extract(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AS this_year, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM submission_month) = extract(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) AS last_year FROM ai_cube GROUP BY extract(month FROM submission_month) ORDER BY month_no

questions.question: Which sites sent fewer cases this month than their 3-month average?
questions.description: Cases this month (so far) against each site's average of the previous three months, with the percent change.
questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date) AS this_month, round(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '3 months')::date AND submission_month < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date) / 3.0, 1) AS avg_last_3_months FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(this_month, 0) AS this_month, avg_last_3_months, round(100.0 * (coalesce(this_month, 0) - avg_last_3_months) / NULLIF(avg_last_3_months, 0), 1) AS change_pct FROM m WHERE avg_last_3_months > 0 ORDER BY change_pct

questions.question: Which sub-centres sent fewer cases this month than their 3-month average?
questions.description: Cases this month at each level-5 unit (sub-centre in the state projects) against its average of the previous three months.
questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date) AS this_month, round(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '3 months')::date AND submission_month < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date) / 3.0, 1) AS avg_last_3_months FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l5_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name) SELECT org_l5_name, org_l1_name, project_id, coalesce(this_month, 0) AS this_month, avg_last_3_months, round(100.0 * (coalesce(this_month, 0) - avg_last_3_months) / NULLIF(avg_last_3_months, 0), 1) AS change_pct FROM m WHERE avg_last_3_months > 0 ORDER BY change_pct

questions.question: Which sub-centres have sent no cases this month or last month?
questions.description: Level-5 units (sub-centres) that sent cases before but none since the start of last month, with their last case month.
questions.sql: SELECT org_l5_name, org_l1_name, project_id, max(submission_month) AS last_case_month, sum(n) AS cases_ever FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l5_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name HAVING max(submission_month) < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '1 month')::date ORDER BY last_case_month

questions.question: What share of interviews is telephonic, by site?
questions.description: Telephonic consents as a percentage of consented interviews per site, with the all-sites share.
questions.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE consent_mode IN ('yes', 'telephonic_consent')) AS base, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE consent_mode = 'telephonic_consent') AS hits FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(hits, 0) AS telephonic, round(100.0 * hits / NULLIF(base, 0), 1) AS telephonic_pct, round(100.0 * sum(hits) OVER () / NULLIF(sum(base) OVER (), 0), 1) AS all_sites_pct, rank() OVER (ORDER BY hits::numeric / NULLIF(base, 0) DESC NULLS LAST) AS rank FROM s ORDER BY telephonic_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Why did data managers mark cases not codeable, by site?
questions.description: Cases marked not codeable by a data manager, by site and recorded reason.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, dm_not_codeable_reason, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE dm_not_codeable_reason IS NOT NULL GROUP BY site_id, dm_not_codeable_reason ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question: Which sites have the most ODK sync problems?
questions.description: Cases with an ODK sync issue by site and issue code. Cases retired from ODK are excluded from every AI table.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, odk_sync_issue_code, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE odk_sync_issue_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY site_id, odk_sync_issue_code ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question: Where is narrative quality falling month on month?
questions.description: Mean narrative quality score per site and month over the last six months, with the change from the previous month.
questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT site_id, submission_month, round(sum(nqa_score_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(nqa_scored_n), 0), 2) AS avg_score FROM ai_cube WHERE submission_month >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '6 months')::date GROUP BY site_id, submission_month) SELECT site_id, submission_month, avg_score, avg_score - lag(avg_score) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY submission_month) AS change FROM m ORDER BY site_id, submission_month

questions.question: How does this month compare with the same month last year at each site?
questions.description: Cases this month (so far) against the same calendar month last year, per site, with the percent change.
questions.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date) AS this_month, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month = (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '1 year')::date) AS same_month_last_year FROM ai_cube GROUP BY site_id) SELECT site_id, coalesce(this_month, 0) AS this_month, coalesce(same_month_last_year, 0) AS same_month_last_year, round(100.0 * (coalesce(this_month, 0) - same_month_last_year) / NULLIF(same_month_last_year, 0), 1) AS change_pct FROM m ORDER BY change_pct NULLS LAST

questions.question: In which narration languages is coding held back?
questions.description: Cases waiting for or in coding per narration language, and their share of that language's cases.
questions.sql: SELECT narration_language, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state IN ('ready_for_coding', 'coding_in_progress')) AS backlog, sum(n) AS cases, round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE workflow_state IN ('ready_for_coding', 'coding_in_progress')) / NULLIF(sum(n), 0), 1) AS backlog_pct FROM ai_cube GROUP BY narration_language ORDER BY backlog DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How does the backlog in each language compare with the coders who code in it?
questions.description: Coding backlog per narration language against coders with that coding language, and those signed in within 30 days. A coder granted at two places counts once per place.
questions.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT narration_language AS lang, sum(n) AS backlog FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state IN ('ready_for_coding', 'coding_in_progress') GROUP BY narration_language), c AS (SELECT coding_language AS lang, sum(staff) AS coders, sum(signed_in_30d) AS active_coders FROM ai_staff WHERE role = 'coder' AND coding_language IS NOT NULL GROUP BY coding_language) SELECT b.lang AS narration_language, b.backlog, coalesce(c.coders, 0) AS coders, coalesce(c.active_coders, 0) AS coders_signed_in_30d, round(b.backlog::numeric / NULLIF(c.active_coders, 0), 1) AS backlog_per_active_coder FROM b LEFT JOIN c ON c.lang = b.lang ORDER BY b.backlog DESC

questions.question: Which sites have a coding backlog but no active coder?
questions.description: Coding backlog per site against coders granted for that site and those signed in within 30 days. Project-wide and unit coders are not counted here.
questions.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT project_id, site_id, sum(n) AS backlog FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state IN ('ready_for_coding', 'coding_in_progress') GROUP BY project_id, site_id), c AS (SELECT project_id, site_id, sum(staff) AS coders, sum(signed_in_30d) AS active FROM ai_staff WHERE role = 'coder' AND coding_language IS NULL AND site_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, site_id) SELECT b.site_id, b.project_id, b.backlog, coalesce(c.coders, 0) AS site_coders, coalesce(c.active, 0) AS site_coders_signed_in_30d FROM b LEFT JOIN c ON c.project_id = b.project_id AND c.site_id = b.site_id ORDER BY coalesce(c.active, 0), b.backlog DESC

questions.question: How many cases were finalised this week compared with last week?
questions.description: Final causes saved this ISO week (so far) and last week, by site.
questions.sql: SELECT site_id, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE final_saved_week = date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE)::date) AS this_week, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE final_saved_week = (date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 week')::date) AS last_week FROM ai_cube WHERE final_saved_week >= (date_trunc('week', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 week')::date GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY this_week DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many final causes were saved each week over the last 12 weeks?
questions.description: Final causes saved per ISO week, with the change from the week before.
questions.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT final_saved_week, sum(n) AS finals FROM ai_cube WHERE final_saved_week >= (CURRENT_DATE - interval '12 weeks')::date GROUP BY final_saved_week) SELECT final_saved_week, finals, finals - lag(finals) OVER (ORDER BY final_saved_week) AS change FROM w ORDER BY final_saved_week

questions.question: What is the reviewer queue per site against the reviewers available?
questions.description: Cases eligible for or in review per site against reviewers granted for that site. Project-wide and unit reviewers are not counted here.
questions.sql: WITH b AS (SELECT project_id, site_id, sum(n) AS queue FROM ai_cube WHERE workflow_state IN ('reviewer_eligible', 'reviewer_coding_in_progress') GROUP BY project_id, site_id), r AS (SELECT project_id, site_id, sum(staff) AS reviewers, sum(signed_in_30d) AS active FROM ai_staff WHERE role = 'reviewer' AND coding_language IS NULL AND site_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, site_id) SELECT b.site_id, b.project_id, b.queue, coalesce(r.reviewers, 0) AS site_reviewers, coalesce(r.active, 0) AS site_reviewers_signed_in_30d FROM b LEFT JOIN r ON r.project_id = b.project_id AND r.site_id = b.site_id ORDER BY b.queue DESC

questions.question: Which coders finalise fastest? Minutes from allocation to final, against peers
questions.description: Per coder over the last three months: finals, average elapsed minutes from allocation to final save and share under 3 minutes, against the project median share. Elapsed time, not time on screen.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(finals) AS finals, round(sum(alloc_to_final_min_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(sum(timed_finals), 0), 1) AS avg_minutes, round(100.0 * sum(finals_under_3_min) / NULLIF(sum(timed_finals), 0), 1) AS under_3_min_pct FROM ai_coder WHERE month >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '3 months')::date GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(timed_finals) >= 5), p AS (SELECT project_id, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY under_3_min_pct) AS median_pct FROM c GROUP BY project_id) SELECT c.coder_name, c.project_id, c.finals, c.avg_minutes, c.under_3_min_pct, round(p.median_pct::numeric, 1) AS peer_median_pct FROM c JOIN p ON p.project_id = c.project_id ORDER BY c.under_3_min_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Which coders finalised the most cases last month, against the project median?
questions.description: Finals per coder in the last full month against the median coder of the same project.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(finals) AS finals FROM ai_coder WHERE month = (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '1 month')::date GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(finals) > 0), p AS (SELECT project_id, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY finals) AS median_finals FROM c GROUP BY project_id) SELECT c.coder_name, c.project_id, c.finals, round(p.median_finals::numeric, 1) AS project_median, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY c.project_id ORDER BY c.finals DESC) AS rank FROM c JOIN p ON p.project_id = c.project_id ORDER BY c.finals DESC

questions.question: Which coders give an unknown cause most often, against peers?
questions.description: Share of each coder's finals in the cause-unknown section, against the project average of coders.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(finals) AS finals, round(100.0 * sum(unknown_cause) / NULLIF(sum(finals), 0), 1) AS unknown_pct FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(finals) >= 10) SELECT c.*, round(avg(unknown_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 1) AS peer_average FROM c ORDER BY unknown_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Which coders disagree most with SmartVA, against peers?
questions.description: Share of each coder's finals whose WHO cause differs from SmartVA's top cause, where SmartVA gave one, against the project average.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(smartva_compared) AS compared, round(100.0 - 100.0 * sum(smartva_match) / NULLIF(sum(smartva_compared), 0), 1) AS disagree_pct FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(smartva_compared) >= 10) SELECT c.*, round(avg(disagree_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 1) AS peer_average FROM c ORDER BY disagree_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Whose finals are most often changed by a reviewer?
questions.description: Per coder: finals a reviewer also coded and the share where the reviewer's code differs, against the project average.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(reviewer_finals) AS reviewed, round(100.0 * sum(reviewer_changed) / NULLIF(sum(reviewer_finals), 0), 1) AS changed_pct FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(reviewer_finals) > 0) SELECT c.*, round(avg(changed_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 1) AS peer_average FROM c ORDER BY changed_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Which coders mark the most cases not codeable?
questions.description: Per coder: cases marked not codeable and their share of the coder's finals plus marks, against the project average.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(not_codeable) AS not_codeable, round(100.0 * sum(not_codeable) / NULLIF(sum(finals) + sum(not_codeable), 0), 1) AS not_codeable_pct FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(finals) + sum(not_codeable) >= 10) SELECT c.*, round(avg(not_codeable_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 1) AS peer_average FROM c ORDER BY not_codeable_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Which coders appear to copy SmartVA?
questions.description: Per coder: share of finals matching SmartVA's top WHO cause, the same share when SmartVA's likelihood is low ('Somewhat Likely' or 'Possible'), exact ICD-10 matches and finals under 3 minutes, against the project average of the low-likelihood share. High agreement when SmartVA is unsure, with fast finals, is the strongest signal.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(finals) AS finals, round(100.0 * sum(smartva_match) / NULLIF(sum(smartva_compared), 0), 1) AS match_pct, round(100.0 * sum(smartva_match_low_likelihood) / NULLIF(sum(smartva_low_likelihood), 0), 1) AS match_when_unlikely_pct, round(100.0 * sum(exact_icd_match) / NULLIF(sum(smartva_compared), 0), 1) AS exact_icd_pct, round(100.0 * sum(finals_under_3_min) / NULLIF(sum(timed_finals), 0), 1) AS under_3_min_pct FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(smartva_compared) >= 10) SELECT c.*, round(avg(match_when_unlikely_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 1) AS peer_average FROM c ORDER BY match_when_unlikely_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: Which coders get the most DORIS flags?
questions.description: Per coder in ICD-11 DORIS projects: finals checked by DORIS, rejections, warnings, age/sex confirmations, causing-condition-unknown uses and finals that differ from DORIS's underlying cause.
questions.sql: SELECT coder_name, project_id, sum(doris_checked) AS checked, sum(doris_rejections) AS rejections, sum(doris_warnings) AS warnings, sum(age_sex_confirmations) AS age_sex_confirmations, sum(causing_condition_unknown) AS causing_condition_unknown, sum(doris_overridden) AS overrides FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(doris_checked) > 0 ORDER BY sum(doris_rejections) + sum(doris_warnings) DESC

questions.question: Which coders give an unknown cause most often in neonatal deaths?
questions.description: Share of each coder's neonatal finals in the cause-unknown section, against the project average.
questions.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT coder_number, coder_name, project_id, sum(neonate_finals) AS neonatal_finals, round(100.0 * sum(neonate_unknown_cause) / NULLIF(sum(neonate_finals), 0), 1) AS unknown_pct FROM ai_coder GROUP BY coder_number, coder_name, project_id HAVING sum(neonate_finals) >= 5) SELECT c.*, round(avg(unknown_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 1) AS peer_average FROM c ORDER BY unknown_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many users were granted a role but have never signed in?
questions.description: Active users per role and the number and share who have never signed in.
questions.sql: SELECT role, sum(staff) AS staff, sum(never_signed_in) AS never_signed_in, round(100.0 * sum(never_signed_in) / NULLIF(sum(staff), 0), 1) AS never_pct FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL GROUP BY role ORDER BY never_signed_in DESC

questions.question: Which sites have dormant grants for 30 days?
questions.description: Users granted over 30 days ago who have not signed in for 30 days, per project, site and role.
questions.sql: SELECT project_id, site_id, role, sum(staff) AS staff, sum(dormant_30d) AS dormant_30d FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL GROUP BY project_id, site_id, role HAVING sum(dormant_30d) > 0 ORDER BY dormant_30d DESC

questions.question: How many users have an unverified email, by role?
questions.description: Active users per role whose email is not verified.
questions.sql: SELECT role, sum(staff) AS staff, sum(unverified_email) AS unverified_email FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL GROUP BY role ORDER BY unverified_email DESC

questions.question: Are newly granted users signing in?
questions.description: Users granted in the last 30 days per role, against those signed in within 7 days and those never signed in.
questions.sql: SELECT role, sum(granted_30d) AS granted_30d, sum(signed_in_7d) AS signed_in_7d, sum(never_signed_in) AS never_signed_in FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL GROUP BY role HAVING sum(granted_30d) > 0 ORDER BY granted_30d DESC

questions.question: Which units have a coder but no interviewer, or an interviewer but no coder?
questions.description: Org units holding unit grants, with coders and interviewers granted at that unit, where one of the two is missing.
questions.sql: SELECT project_id, coalesce(org_l7_name, org_l6_name, org_l5_name, org_l4_name, org_l3_name, org_l2_name, org_l1_name) AS unit_name, coalesce(sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE role = 'coder'), 0) AS coders, coalesce(sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE role = 'interviewer'), 0) AS interviewers FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL AND org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING coalesce(sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE role = 'coder'), 0) = 0 OR coalesce(sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE role = 'interviewer'), 0) = 0 ORDER BY 1, 2

questions.question: Which sub-centres have cases but no interviewer?
questions.description: Level-5 units (sub-centres) with cases, with no interviewer granted at that unit.
questions.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l5_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name), i AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name, sum(staff) AS interviewers FROM ai_staff WHERE role = 'interviewer' AND coding_language IS NULL AND org_l5_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name) SELECT u.org_l5_name, u.org_l1_name, u.project_id, u.cases FROM u LEFT JOIN i ON i.project_id = u.project_id AND i.org_l1_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM u.org_l1_name AND i.org_l5_name = u.org_l5_name WHERE i.interviewers IS NULL ORDER BY u.cases DESC

questions.question: Which districts with cases have no coder or no interviewer?
questions.description: Level-1 units (districts) with cases against coders and interviewers granted inside that district. Project and site grants are not counted here.
questions.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, sum(n) AS cases FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name), s AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE role = 'coder') AS coders, sum(staff) FILTER (WHERE role = 'interviewer') AS interviewers FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL AND org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name) SELECT d.org_l1_name, d.project_id, d.cases, coalesce(s.coders, 0) AS coders, coalesce(s.interviewers, 0) AS interviewers FROM d LEFT JOIN s ON s.project_id = d.project_id AND s.org_l1_name = d.org_l1_name ORDER BY coalesce(s.coders, 0) + coalesce(s.interviewers, 0), d.cases DESC

questions.question: Which districts have staff who have not started training?
questions.description: Users granted in each district, those added to a training session and those who started one. DigitVA does not record training completion.
questions.sql: SELECT org_l1_name, project_id, sum(staff) AS staff, sum(in_training) AS in_training, sum(training_started) AS training_started FROM ai_staff WHERE coding_language IS NULL AND org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name ORDER BY sum(staff) - sum(training_started) DESC

questions.question: Which coders lack a coding language?
questions.description: Coders with no coding language set, per project and site.
questions.sql: SELECT project_id, site_id, sum(staff) AS coders, sum(no_coding_language) AS no_coding_language FROM ai_staff WHERE role = 'coder' AND coding_language IS NULL GROUP BY project_id, site_id ORDER BY no_coding_language DESC

questions.question: What are the top causes by district, against the state?
questions.description: The five most frequent WHO causes in each level-1 unit (district), with the district share and the project (state) share of the same cause.
questions.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, authoritative_who_bucket, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l1_name IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name, authoritative_who_bucket), r AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, authoritative_who_bucket, deaths, round(100.0 * deaths / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id, org_l1_name), 0), 1) AS district_pct, round(100.0 * sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id, authoritative_who_bucket) / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 0), 1) AS state_pct, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY project_id, org_l1_name ORDER BY deaths DESC) AS position FROM d) SELECT org_l1_name, authoritative_who_bucket, deaths, district_pct, state_pct, project_id FROM r WHERE position <= 5 ORDER BY project_id, org_l1_name, deaths DESC

questions.question: How many maternal deaths were there by district and month?
questions.description: Deaths in the pregnancy, childbirth and puerperium section per level-1 unit (district) and submission month.
questions.sql: SELECT org_l1_name, submission_month, sum(n) AS maternal_deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Pregnancy-, childbirth and puerperium-related disorders' GROUP BY org_l1_name, submission_month ORDER BY org_l1_name, submission_month

questions.question: Are neonatal and child deaths by district above or below the state rate?
questions.description: Neonatal and child deaths as a share of all deaths per level-1 unit (district), against the project (state) share.
questions.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, sum(n) AS deaths, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = 'neonate') AS neonatal, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = 'child') AS child FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name) SELECT org_l1_name, project_id, deaths, round(100.0 * neonatal / NULLIF(deaths, 0), 1) AS neonatal_pct, round(100.0 * child / NULLIF(deaths, 0), 1) AS child_pct, round(100.0 * sum(neonatal) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 0), 1) AS state_neonatal_pct, round(100.0 * sum(child) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 0), 1) AS state_child_pct FROM d ORDER BY neonatal_pct NULLS LAST

questions.question: Injury and suicide deaths by district, sex and age
questions.description: External-cause and intentional self-harm deaths per level-1 unit (district), by sex and among 15 to 49 year olds.
questions.sql: SELECT org_l1_name, sum(n) AS injury_deaths, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket = 'Intentional self-harm') AS self_harm, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'male') AS male, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'female') AS female, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = '15_49y') AS age_15_49 FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'External causes of death' GROUP BY org_l1_name ORDER BY injury_deaths DESC

questions.question: Which districts have the highest unknown-cause share?
questions.description: Coded deaths in the cause-unknown section as a share of coded deaths per level-1 unit (district), against the project share.
questions.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL) AS coded, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Cause of death unknown') AS unknown FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name) SELECT org_l1_name, project_id, coded, round(100.0 * unknown / NULLIF(coded, 0), 1) AS unknown_pct, round(100.0 * sum(unknown) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) / NULLIF(sum(coded) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 0), 1) AS state_pct FROM d ORDER BY unknown_pct DESC NULLS LAST

questions.question: How many VA cases does each district have, and which have none recently?
questions.description: Cases, coded cases and the last case month per level-1 unit (district). Districts that never sent a case do not appear.
questions.sql: SELECT org_l1_name, project_id, sum(n) AS cases, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_source IS NOT NULL) AS coded, max(submission_month) AS last_case_month FROM ai_cube GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name ORDER BY cases DESC

questions.question: Which sub-centres report fewer deaths than comparable units?
questions.description: Deaths per level-5 unit (sub-centre) in the last three months against the median sub-centre of the same district and against its own previous three months.
questions.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name, coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '3 months')::date), 0) AS last_3_months, coalesce(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE submission_month >= (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '6 months')::date AND submission_month < (date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)::date - interval '3 months')::date), 0) AS prior_3_months FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l5_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name, org_l5_name), p AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY last_3_months) AS district_median FROM u GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name) SELECT u.org_l5_name, u.org_l1_name, u.project_id, u.last_3_months, u.prior_3_months, round(p.district_median::numeric, 1) AS district_median FROM u JOIN p ON p.project_id = u.project_id AND p.org_l1_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM u.org_l1_name ORDER BY u.last_3_months - p.district_median

questions.question: Which districts report few neonatal, female or maternal deaths compared with the state?
questions.description: Neonatal, female and maternal deaths as shares of all deaths per level-1 unit (district), against the project (state) shares.
questions.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, sum(n) AS deaths, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE analytics_age_band = 'neonate') AS neonatal, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE lower(sex) = 'female') AS female, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Pregnancy-, childbirth and puerperium-related disorders') AS maternal FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name) SELECT org_l1_name, project_id, deaths, round(100.0 * female / NULLIF(deaths, 0), 1) AS female_pct, round(100.0 * sum(female) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 0), 1) AS state_female_pct, round(100.0 * neonatal / NULLIF(deaths, 0), 1) AS neonatal_pct, round(100.0 * maternal / NULLIF(deaths, 0), 1) AS maternal_pct FROM d ORDER BY female_pct NULLS FIRST

questions.question: How often does SmartVA agree with the physician by district?
questions.description: Share of coded deaths where SmartVA's top WHO cause equals the final cause, per level-1 unit (district), against the project share.
questions.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT project_id, org_l1_name, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket IS NOT NULL AND authoritative_who_bucket IS NOT NULL) AS compared, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE smartva_cause1_who_bucket = authoritative_who_bucket) AS agree FROM ai_cube WHERE org_l1_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_id, org_l1_name) SELECT org_l1_name, project_id, compared, round(100.0 * agree / NULLIF(compared, 0), 1) AS agreement_pct, round(100.0 * sum(agree) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id) / NULLIF(sum(compared) OVER (PARTITION BY project_id), 0), 1) AS state_pct FROM d ORDER BY agreement_pct NULLS LAST

questions.question: Is there a seasonal pattern in infectious deaths?
questions.description: Infectious and parasitic disease deaths per calendar month, this year and last year.
questions.sql: SELECT extract(month FROM submission_month)::int AS month_no, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM submission_month) = extract(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)) AS this_year, sum(n) FILTER (WHERE extract(year FROM submission_month) = extract(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1) AS last_year FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section = 'Infectious and parasitic diseases' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY month_no

questions.question: How does each site's cause mix compare with the project mix?
questions.description: Share of coded deaths per WHO cause section at each site against the same share for all sites.
questions.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT site_id, authoritative_who_bucket_section AS section, sum(n) AS deaths FROM ai_cube WHERE authoritative_who_bucket_section IS NOT NULL GROUP BY site_id, authoritative_who_bucket_section) SELECT site_id, section, deaths, round(100.0 * deaths / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id), 0), 1) AS site_pct, round(100.0 * sum(deaths) OVER (PARTITION BY section) / NULLIF(sum(deaths) OVER (), 0), 1) AS all_sites_pct FROM s ORDER BY site_id, deaths DESC
